name: Datawrapper
tagline: Datawrapper turns a pasted spreadsheet into a responsive chart or map in a few clicks, with the clean, annotation-friendly style that news outlets like the BBC and the New York Times use for data journalism. No coding is required, and every chart embeds as a lightweight, mobile-ready iframe that updates automatically if the underlying data changes. It built its name in newsrooms, but marketing and research teams now use it the same way for reports and blog posts.
